test_policy.notes: Rutgers-Newark is test blind: SAT and ACT are not required and are not used for most undergraduate applicants. Only applicants to the Rutgers-Newark 7-year BA/MD joint-degree program must submit a score. Scores on file can be used for placement exemption (CDS). Rutgers states its test-optional and test-blind policies run through 2027.

requirements.supplemental_essays: A short original essay is required on the Rutgers Application or Common App (no Common App supplement); a short statement is needed to be considered for honors.
requirements.notes: $70 non-refundable fee, same for Common App and Rutgers Application. Letters of recommendation are not used. International-school applicants self-report courses and grades in STARS; official documents are required of admitted students. Admitted students complete an I-20 financial statement (ISFS) with bank documentation. Open to F-1 first-year applicants for fall 2027 in Arts & Sciences, Rutgers Business School, School of Criminal Justice and School of Public Affairs and Administration (availability chart as of 2026-10-26).

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding), fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Dates apply to all first-year applicants including international; there is no separate international deadline. These are not hard cutoffs: you may apply later while the school still has space. Candidate reply date May 1, 2027.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Decisions posted online no later than Feb 28, 2027; reply date May 1, 2027. Applications after Dec 1 are reviewed only while schools of application have not met enrollment goals. The CDS (fall 2023) described a Dec 1 priority date with rolling notification.

deadlines.label: Candidate's reply date (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Students admitted after May 1 must respond within one week of admission.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of all students whose secondary schooling was outside the U.S. in a country where English is not the principal language, regardless of residency status; scores must be from the past two years. May be waived case by case for English-medium schooling (email RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu). Exempt with a B or better in a college-level English Composition course at an accredited U.S. college (not ESL or online). Also accepted: SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 21, Michigan English Test 56. Nursing and pharmacy have higher minimums.

english.notes: Internet-based test and Home Edition, taken through January 21, 2026. Rutgers TOEFL code 2765.
Exams from January 22, 2026 onward (Newark 4.0; New Brunswick 4.5). The page lists the value without naming the 1-6 scale.
Newark minimum is 6.5 as of January 1, 2024.
130 for the Ernest Mario School of Pharmacy and School of Nursing.
Cambridge Assessment test at level B2 (no numeric score given).

aid.notes: CDS H6: no institutional need-based aid for nonresidents; institutional non-need-based aid is available (31 nonresidents received it, average $7,467 in the CDS year). The Newark scholarships page (Chancellor's Scholarship up to $5,000 a year, Carr Scholarship) lists U.S. citizen, national or permanent-resident eligibility and does not mention F-1 students, so no published international scholarship was confirmed (merit_scholarships left null).

sat.note: Rutgers-Newark is test blind; no SAT code is needed except for the BA/MD program. No code is printed on the admissions pages checked.

act.note: Rutgers-Newark is test blind; no ACT code is needed except for the BA/MD program. No code is printed on the admissions pages checked.

ielts.note: No IELTS institution code is listed on the Rutgers pages.

duolingo.note: No Duolingo institution code is listed on the Rutgers pages.

pte.note: PTE is not on Rutgers' list of accepted English tests.

tier_notes.general: Editorial judgment: part of the Rutgers research university; admits about 79% of applicants (70% of international applicants, CDS fall 2023) and is test blind, so an SAT ~1100 international applicant is a likely admit if the English requirement is met. Placed just above the open-access D tier.
